content.title: IonQ Stock Heads for a Record High. This Acquisition Got Clearance.
content.summary: Shares of  IonQ  surged Friday after the quantum-computing company said the UK Investment Security Unit had cleared its acquisition of Oxford Ionics, a British start-up.  The companies in June said they entered into a definitive agreement for  IonQ  to acquire Oxford Ionics for $1.075 billion, in a transaction consisting of $1.065 billion in IonQ shares plus $10 million in cash.  Speaking at the company’s investor day on Friday, CEO Niccolo de Masi said IonQ was the “best-capitalized company” in the sector.
